sources.entry: Interview: David Zhang from Aomni gives his view agents' reliability, debugging and orchestration

summary.name: Aomni
summary.one_liner: Aomni is a web-crawling AI research agent for sales market research and account planning, and this E2B interview covers founder David Zhang's views on agent reliability, debugging and orchestration.
summary.what_it_does: Aomni takes a user's research goal, builds a research plan, works through the steps one by one while crawling the web and ingesting unstructured data, and emails the result. A run takes about 15-20 minutes. The page says users can run it 3 times a day for free. The interview describes Aomni's narrow design: the founder limits the number of tools and decisions the agent makes. It also covers his view that agent developers should target about 99.9% reliability for enterprise customers. He describes using Inngest for run tracking and orchestration and says it lacks step-level retries.
notable: Runs a multi-step research plan and emails the finished report after 15-20 minutes
Deliberately narrow tool set to improve reliability
Uses Inngest for orchestration and run debugging, per the founder
Founder argues for time-travel debugging built on existing workflow engines
caveats: Free use is limited to 3 runs per day, per the page
Founder says Inngest cannot retry from a specific step in the middle of a run
